status_help: The built-in frp client keeps this node reachable through your frp server.
stop_note: Stop does not change the saved Enabled switch: the client starts again at the next boot.
server_help: Where the client connects. Tunnels never point at this node's public port: they go through two loopback gateways that keep the visitor's real address.
enabled_help: Run the client. Off by default.
tls_help: Encrypt the connection to the frp server. Leave it on: the token is sent while logging in.
tls_off_warning: Without TLS the token is sent in clear text during login.
token_help: Shared secret of the frp server. Never shown again after it is saved.
secret_saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
secret_will_clear: It will be cleared when you save.
expose_cluster_warning: When on, anyone who can reach your frp server's public port can reach this node's /api/cluster endpoint (the node-to-node websocket), protected only by the cluster key. Leave it off unless your nodes reach each other through this tunnel.
expose_cluster_confirm: Anyone who can reach your frp server's public port will be able to reach this node's cluster endpoint. Turn it on only if your nodes connect to each other through this tunnel.
proxies_help: One entry per tunnel. Changing only the proxies reloads them without dropping the connection to the server.

proxy.name: Name
proxy.no_https: HTTPS proxies are not offered: they would need a certificate on this node. Use HTTP behind your frp server's TLS, or a TCP proxy.
proxy.domains_help: One per line, or separated by commas.
proxy.remote_port_help: The port opened on the frp server (1 to 65535).
proxy.secret_help: Visitors need this key to connect. Never shown again after it is saved.

errors.name_invalid: The name must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -.
errors.http_needs_host: An HTTP proxy needs a custom domain or a subdomain.
errors.tcp_needs_port: A TCP proxy needs a remote port from 1 to 65535.
errors.stcp_needs_secret: An STCP proxy needs a secret key.
errors.server_invalid: The server address must be a host name or an IP address.
errors.port_invalid: The server port must be from 1 to 65535.
